text.p: Newcastle's faint English championship hopes all but disappeared on Sunday when they could only draw 1-1 at Wimbldeon.
Newcastle remained fourth in the standings with a game in hand but trailed leaders Manchester United by 11 points.
Newcastle have never won at Wimbledon and looked to be heading for defeat when Norwegian Oyvind Leonhardson's 28th minute shot took a wicked bounce to beat goalkeeper Shaka Hislop.

But the visitors salvaged a point eight minutes into the second half when Colombian Faustino Asprilla curled a free-kick past Neil Sullivan after Frenchman David Ginola had been fouled on the edge of the box.
